verdict.rationale: First-party docs show requests are created and kept inside collections (docs-15, docs-43), and folder-scoped environments imply folder organization (docs-54). Saved requests can be rerun anytime, singly or in order via the Collection Runner with unlimited runs (docs-20, docs-4, docs-55), and Inso CLI can automate them (docs-3). A community user also values recalling frequent requests without re-entering data (comm-6). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of creating and nesting folders, and independent hands-on corroboration of collection and folder organization and reruns.
